blocks.text: Banda responds to the suffering by arguing that a spoken vow must be upheld even in ruin, and he supports this with examples from saints, rulers, and old sacred history.
Figures such as Harishchandra and Guru Tegh Bahadur are invoked to show that honor and truth are weightier than bodily preservation.
The page uses remembered exemplars to convert hunger and despair back into discipline.
